disabled.title: Observability is not enabled
disabled.description: This deployment has not switched on AI observability, so no runs are being collected.

empty.title: No data collected yet
empty.description: Once collection is enabled, runs across your scope appear here.

forbidden.title: Outside your admin scope
forbidden.description: This view covers the deployments and Bots your administration extends to.

basic.title: Basic-level runtimes
basic.description: Some runtimes report at basic level: what passed through OpenBot is collected, their internal steps are not. This is a capability level, not a missing service.

omitted.title: Content omitted
omitted.description: Content across this view was withheld by the redaction policy before it was stored.

truncated.title: Content truncated
truncated.description: Content exceeding the field limits was cut short before storage; the full content was never kept.

syncing.title: Collection is behind
syncing.description: The export queue is still delivering records; counts catch up on their own.

unavailable.title: Observability backend unreachable
unavailable.description: The tracking service could not be reached, so summaries cannot be shown right now. Agent runs themselves were not affected.
